newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss apologise for training tanks against Italy.
newsitem.headline: Swiss apologise for training tanks against Italy.

text.p: The Swiss Defence Ministry issued an embarrassed apology on Friday for staging army tank exercises to ward off an imaginary invasion from an unrecognised "state" declared by secessionists in neighbouring Italy.

The exercise last month could have been seen as offensive to Italy, where authorities have launched an investigation into alleged anti-constitutional activity by the Northern League, which declared the region of Padania "independent" in September.
The Swiss defence ministry issued a statement offering a general apology in the name of the tank battalion commander to anyone who might have been offended by the exercise.
The ministry is especially sensitive about army manoeuvres following controversy over another drill in June which involved soldiers pretending to break up a riot by jobless Swiss.

The statement said last month's scenario had tanks blocking the border to northern Italy after Italian-speaking Swiss demonstrated in favour of joining Padania, the would-be republic in northern Italy declared by secessionist leader Umberto Bossi.
"In addition, 'Padania' was supposed to have decided to give military aid to its (Swiss) sympathisers," the ministry statement said about the drill.

Switzerland's militia-style army holds frequent manoeuvres to keep its draftee force trim for defending the neutral state, although it has not fought a battle since losing to a French army in 1515 at Marignano -- in what is now Italy.
The last time its soldiers opened fire was to mow down striking workers in Geneva in 1932, killing 13.
